tldr: Sun in the 4th house: identity and vitality center on home, family, and roots
body: Sun in the 4th house: identity and vitality center on home, family, and roots. Gift: you shine there. Watch: ego tied to it. With the Sun in the 4th house, identity, vitality, visibility, and the need to live from a clear center move through home, family, roots, privacy, and emotional foundations. This makes what makes you feel rooted, protected, and emotionally held a central part of the life. Used consciously, this placement can become presence, confidence, creative authority, and a stronger sense of purpose. Left unconscious, it can become over-identifying with this area, needing recognition here, or confusing attention with self-worth.
gift: presence, confidence, creative authority, and a stronger sense of purpose expressed through home and roots.
challenge: over-identifying with this area, needing recognition here, or confusing attention with self-worth concentrated in home and roots.
note: Merged with approved project planet-through-house material; source file was not copied into the repository.
